topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: The package arrived on my doorstep, unexpected, wrapped in paper I didn’t recognize. My hands trembled as I unwrapped it, the edges of the paper crinkling loudly in the quiet of my home. Inside, nestled among layers of tissue, was a simple frame. A drawing, childish yet heartwarmingly detailed, a scene from our last class together. The note attached was brief, thanking me for my guidance, for the impact I had made. The words blurred as I read them, the air suddenly thick. I glanced outside, the world a bit more uncertain, the shadows a little darker. I placed the gift carefully on the shelf, away from where I usually sit, and turned on a light, bright and unyielding.
